response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished and versatile software engineer with strong craftsmanship practices and emerging leadership experience, he falls significantly short on critical minimum qualifications. Most notably, he has only approximately 6 months of C++ programming experience versus the required 8 years, and his large-scale infrastructure experience (~3 years across Dunnhumby and Optilyz) is below the required 5 years. Though he demonstrates mentoring capability and technical depth across multiple domains, these fundamental gaps in core technical requirements make him unsuitable for this mid-senior technical lead role.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship background with demonstrated expertise in TDD, CI/CD, code quality practices, and engineering best practices
Proven mentoring and teaching ability evidenced by Refactoring Dojos, workshops, courses, and open-source contributions (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial)
Relevant distributed systems and cloud infrastructure exposure including high-scale microservices (millions of requests/second), AWS CDK, and Kubernetes deployments
concerns: Critical C++ experience gap: approximately 6 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years minimum qualification
Insufficient large-scale infrastructure tenure: roughly 3 years of dedicated infrastructure/distributed systems work versus the required 5 years
No formal technical leadership track record: currently Staff Engineer but lacking evidence of multi-year role leading technical strategy or large technical teams
